structure an essay: Before you start writing, think about how to structure an essay with a clear introduction, body, and conclusion.
開始寫之前，想想如何安排文章結構，要有清楚的開頭、主體和結論。
structure one's day: Since working from home, Emma has learned to structure her day by setting fixed times for work and rest.
自從在家工作後，艾瑪學會了安排一天，為工作和休息設定固定時間。
a well-structured argument: The judges praised Tom's speech because it was a well-structured argument with strong reasons in a logical order.
評審稱讚湯姆的演講，因為那是個結構嚴謹的論點，理由有力且順序合乎邏輯。
structure the lesson: The new teacher decided to structure the lesson into three parts: a short review, group work, and a quiz.
新老師決定把課程結構規劃成三部分：簡短複習、小組活動和小考。
struggle with math: Many students struggle with math in senior high, so the school offers free tutoring after class every Tuesday.
許多學生在高中時數學很吃力，所以學校每週二放學後提供免費課輔。
struggle to survive: After the earthquake destroyed their village, the families had to struggle to survive without clean water or food.
地震摧毀他們的村莊後，這些家庭在沒有乾淨水和食物的情況下必須掙扎求生。
struggle against injustice: Throughout his life, the lawyer continued to struggle against injustice by defending poor people who could not pay.
這位律師一生持續對抗不公，為付不起錢的窮人辯護。
struggle to make ends meet: After losing his job, Mr. Lin had to struggle to make ends meet, working two part-time jobs every week.
失業後，林先生只能勉強餬口，每週打兩份兼職工作。
struggle for power: The two generals continued to struggle for power for over ten years, and their bloody war destroyed the country.
兩位將軍持續權力鬥爭超過十年，他們血腥的戰爭摧毀了這個國家。
struggle with addiction: The singer spoke openly about how she had to struggle with addiction to painkillers for many years.
這位歌手公開談論她多年來如何與止痛藥成癮搏鬥。
stuff oneself: At the Lunar New Year dinner, I always stuff myself with so much food that I can hardly move afterward.
在除夕年夜飯，我總是吃撐到飯後幾乎動不了。
stuff the ballot box: The officials were arrested for trying to stuff the ballot box with thousands of fake votes during the election.
這些官員因為在選舉期間企圖用數千張假票灌票而被逮捕。
stuff a turkey: On Thanksgiving morning, my aunt showed me how to stuff a turkey with bread, onions, and herbs before roasting it.
感恩節早上，阿姨示範如何在烤之前用麵包、洋蔥和香草填塞火雞。
know one's stuff: You can trust the mechanic at that shop; he has fixed cars for thirty years and really knows his stuff.
你可以信任那家店的技師；他修車三十年了，真的很內行。
stuff it in a bag: Don't fold your jacket so carefully; just stuff it in a bag, or we will miss the bus.
別那麼仔細摺外套了，直接塞進袋子就好，不然我們會錯過公車。
stuffed with facts: The history textbook is stuffed with facts and dates, so many students find it boring and hard to remember.
這本歷史課本塞滿事實和日期，所以很多學生覺得無聊又難記。
stumble across: While cleaning the attic, I happened to stumble across a box of old letters my grandfather had written.
打掃閣樓時，我偶然發現一箱祖父寫的舊信。
stumble over one's words: Nervous in front of the whole school, Amy began to stumble over her words and forgot what to say next.
在全校面前很緊張，艾美開始說話結巴，忘了接下來要說什麼。
stumble upon: During our hike, we happened to stumble upon a quiet waterfall that was not shown on any map.
健行時，我們碰巧遇到一座任何地圖上都沒標示的寧靜瀑布。
stumble through a speech: Because he had not practiced at all, Kevin could only stumble through a speech, reading slowly from his notes.
因為完全沒練習，凱文只能磕磕絆絆講完演講，慢慢照著筆記唸。
a stumbling block: For many students who want to study abroad, the high cost of living is a stumbling block they cannot easily overcome.
對許多想出國留學的學生來說，高昂的生活費是個不易克服的絆腳石。
stumble in the dark: When the power went out, we had to stumble in the dark to find the flashlight in the kitchen.
停電時，我們只好在黑暗中跌跌撞撞地去廚房找手電筒。
be stunned by the news: The whole class was stunned by the news that our kind and healthy teacher had suddenly passed away.
全班被消息震驚了：我們親切又健康的老師竟突然過世。
stun the audience: The young pianist was able to stun the audience with her amazing skill, and everyone stood up to clap.
這位年輕鋼琴家以驚人技巧震撼觀眾，大家都起立鼓掌。
a stunning victory: The small-town team won a stunning victory over the national champions, scoring five goals in a brilliant final.
這支小鎮球隊以驚人的勝利擊敗全國冠軍，在精彩決賽中踢進五球。
stun the world: The scientists' discovery of water on the distant planet was enough to stun the world and change our view of space.
科學家在遙遠行星上發現水，足以震驚世界並改變我們對太空的看法。
stunned silence: When the principal announced that the school would close next year, the hall fell into stunned silence.
當校長宣布學校明年將關閉時，禮堂陷入一片驚愕的沉默。
subject someone to criticism: Posting such a rude comment online will subject someone to criticism from thousands of angry users.
在網路上發表如此無禮的留言，會使某人受到數千名憤怒網友的批評。
be subjected to tests: Before any new medicine can be sold, it must be subjected to tests to make sure it is safe.
任何新藥在販售前都必須接受測試，以確保其安全。
subject to approval: Your plan for the school trip is subject to approval by the principal, so please hand it in by Friday.
你的校外教學計畫需經校長批准，所以請在週五前交出來。
subject to change: Please note that the concert schedule is subject to change if the weather becomes bad this weekend.
請注意，如果本週末天氣變差，音樂會時程可能變動。
subject a city to attack: The enemy army decided to subject a city to attack from the air, forcing thousands of people to flee.
敵軍決定從空中攻擊一座城市，迫使數千人逃離。
